reason: Runnable (sparse, <5 CPU-min; no Sage) and the structural metric (flattening rank) is right: CP rank >= every flattening rank, so one exact rank is a rigorous lower bound. Defects as stated: (1) ALS CP is only an inexact upper bound and cannot falsify; drop it or use only as a sanity check. (2) Modes 1 and 2 have rank <= 2^l trivially, so only mode 3 is informative. (3) Control is weak: a random tensor of equal density is full rank by construction; there is no positive control proving the instrument can see low rank, so a null result is uninterpretable. (4) The slice V x V x F is the graph of a 2-valued function. For binary S_3, each (a,b) row has <=2 nonzeros, at x(P_a+P_b) and x(P_a-P_b). Mode-3 flattening is the vertex-edge incidence matrix of a graph on F-values, with rank = #touched vertices - #(bipartite) components over Q (F_2: minus #components). For 2l<n this is a near-matching with rank ~2^{2l-1}; for 2l>=n it saturates at ~2^n. Both are >= 2^l. The result is a birthday/collision fact, not a toy artefact, so it does extrapolate to n=131 (hope needs r_T=poly(l) << 2^l; the flattening rank lower bound is min(2^{2l-1},~2^n) >= 2^l for all l>=1), and the kill is near-certain. (5) The chain in the idea needs F x V x F (intermediate point on both sides), not V x V x F. For fixed v this is an involutive x-translation correspondence on F, full rank ~2^n; low-rank there would be a Fourier/character diagonalisation, which requires group structure/DL knowledge (GGM-simulable). The toy must also report it. (6) Parameters n=11,13,15 with l=4..6 give 2^{2l} up to 4096 > 2^11 at n=11,l=6, so rank saturates at 2^n for both arms (confound), and l=4..6 cannot distinguish poly(l) from 2^l (three points). Classification stays 'advance' only if rank slope <=1 in l; the prior is that it is an accounting/relabelling of MITM at best.
fix: REDESIGN. (a) Build the exact graph: pick V = random l-dim F_2-subspace of F_{2^n}; keep a in V only if (a, y) is a rational point (trace test) -- alternative arm keeps all a in V. For each unordered pair {a,b} compute the two roots of binary S_3 (X1X2+X1X3+X2X3)^2+X1X2X3+a6=0 in X3 (quadratic over F_2^n; ffd_s3_formula_control.py has the formula, or PARI ellmul/elladd on points). Edge = {x(a+b), x(a-b)}. (b) Exact lower bound by union-find on edges: rank_F2 = |touched vertices| - #components; rank_Q = |touched vertices| - #bipartite components (verify against modular rank mod 2^61-1 or scipy/numpy rank on n<=13 cells). Sparse and instant, so scan n in 15..31 odd/prime, l in 4..12 with n>=2l+3 (unsaturated regime) AND a second block with 2l>=n (saturated regime). (c) Report log2(rank) vs l and fit slope; success = slope <=1 or rank <= c*l^k; failure = slope ~2 (rank ~2^{2l-1}) or saturation at 2^n. (d) Controls: (i) null: random graph with identical per-row support size (2 random columns from the same column universe, symmetric in (a,b)), same row count, so only collision statistics differ; (ii) positive control with known low rank: additive tensor T[a,b,c]=[c=a+b] (mode-3 rank exactly 2^l, Fourier CP rank 2^l) and a planted tensor with rows drawn from a rank-r span; instrument must return those values; (iii) the actual chain slice M_v[y,z]=[S_3(y,v,z)=0] on F x F for 8 random v in V, n<=15 (2^15 x 2^15 sparse): report rank (expect ~2^n) and, as the tensor-network chain object, the F x V x F mode-2 flattening rank; (iv) report the same for the differences a-b and a+b separately to separate sign symmetry from structure. (e) Metrics are counts only: ranks, edges, components, slope; no wall time. Optionally ALS CP (sparse MTTKRP) only to show upper bound ~ nnz when not low rank. (f) State the scaling implication explicitly: rank >= min(2^{2l-1}, 2^n-ish) >= 2^l implies D ~ r_T*2^l >= 2^{2l-1}, i.e. no gain over the 2^{2l} enumeration, so B*D^2<N cannot be reached; this closes the crate's exponent hope for this tensor family and states scope: excludes only exact CP/Tucker/flattening-based contractions of the S_3 incidence tensor, not approximate/randomised contractions or representation-specific (Weil descent) structure.
